subject.title: [Feature]: make agent aware of communication channel

question: Should this issue be scoped to command prompt metadata parity only, with model-selectable channel delivery left to a separate API/product item?
rationale: The source-confirmed gap is narrow, but the issue also requests selective channel replies, which conflicts with the documented deterministic routing boundary unless maintainers choose a new product/API direction.

options.title: Scope To Prompt Metadata Parity
options.body: Implement only normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and channel action/message guidance in `resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle()`.

options.title: Split Selective Routing Design
options.body: Track model-selectable or rule-driven channel delivery as a separate maintainer-approved API or product design item.

options.title: Close Selective Routing As Not Planned
options.body: Keep deterministic host-controlled routing and document that prompts cannot choose arbitrary delivery channels.

recommendation.title: Scope To Prompt Metadata Parity
recommendation.body: Implement only normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and channel action/message guidance in `resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle()`.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue history, shared bundle authorship, and previous scope comment make this the clearest owner for the prompt-vs-routing decision.
